_meta._purpose: Single source of truth for image-gen pricing per pricing_tier_id. Contracts reference pricing_tier_id; this file holds {cost_per_image, invoice_verified, last_invoice_check_date, source}. Cost moves independently of contract schema, so it lives separately.
_meta._invoice_verified_meaning: true = at least one invoice line item has been reconciled against the cost_per_image at this tier. false = estimate from public docs only. Reconciliation lesson per memory cost_preflight_invoice_recon.md.
_meta.principle: Invoice and pricing data is a spend-control recipe library. Each item exposes a pricing tier that contracts and preflight cost checks can reference without hardcoding rates.
